Our accounting team has exported the Q1 2024 income statement (利润表) from our ERP system. The file is somewhere under the `erp_exports/2024Q1/` folder. We also have the official tax bureau template under `templates/official/`. 

Please fill the ERP data into the official template and save the result as `output_profit.xlsx`. The template has formula cells that must continue to work correctly when we open the file in Excel — do not break any formulas or change any cell formatting. The filled-in subtotal and total rows should reflect the correct computed values from the data you entered.
